item.title: Identities of thousands of Homeland Security employees and contractors disclosed in massive data breach
item.description: An activist group published a searchable database, exposing the identities and contact information for immigration officers, border agents and undercover investigators, according to documents posted online. DHS said it was “aware of a potential breach” and was “working to address the situation swiftly and effectively.”

item.title: Cornell faculty senate moves ahead with no-confidence vote on administration

An online vote will now take place starting Thursday, with results expected Nov. 6.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro is granted a visa to enter the U.S. after fleeing Brazil following his election loss
item.description: The defeated presidential candidate left Brazil for the United States on Tuesday, according to three people with knowledge of the matter, in defiance of a judicial order to surrender his passport. He and members of his family have been granted U.S. visas, a senior State Department official said. Bolsonaro is under investigation for his over financial ties to a banker accused of financial misconduct and to a man suspected of money laundering tied to Brazil’s betting industry.

item.title: Grand jury declines to indict former White House aide Cassidy Hutchinson over Jan. 6 testimony
item.description: Hutchinson testified before lawmakers about President Donald Trump’s actions during the Jan. 6, 2021, attack on the U.S. Capitol. The failure of the Justice Department to secure the indictment marks the latest rebuke of its efforts to prosecute one of the president’s political enemies.
